ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in familiar older hits than a contemporary pop album right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Eagles: The Very Best Of; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: A strong match for my recent classic rock and greatest-hits listening; I would choose this.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Peter, Paul and Mary; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My interest in Simon & Garfunkel and Melanie makes this folk collection especially appealing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Born This Way suggests some interest in modern pop, but this is not what I want this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Huey Lewis Greatest Hits; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for the accessible rock hits, consistent with my interest in The Cars and rock compilations.
ItemID: NA; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This feels less connected to the older rock and folk collections I currently want.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best of Frankie Valli & The 4 Seasons Single; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: This fits my interest in mid-'60s hits and nostalgic best-of collections; I would select it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Cheek to Cheek makes another vocal collaboration appealing, but I would choose the older hits collections first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Greatest Hits: Decade #1; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not establish an artist or a clear connection to my preferences, so I would skip it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Traveller; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have enough interest in this album to choose it over the classic rock and folk options.
